summary.text: Mark Chapman is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 12 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election; he defeated Sandra Hodges in the June 16, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Tiffany Prater in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner and president.

paragraphs.text: Mark Chapman was born in Illinois and earned a high school diploma from Charles Page High School, an associate degree from Oklahoma State University Institute of Technology in 1984 and a bachelor's degree from Southern Nazarene University in 1995.
His career experience includes working as a business owner and president, and he has been affiliated with the NFIB and the county and state Republican Party.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he owns multiple businesses in Broken Arrow, including a professional video equipment dealer, and is also a real estate investor.
Chapman assumed office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Kevin McDugle, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Administrative Rules Committee and the Energy and Natural Resources Oversight Committee.

In the same survey, he listed his campaign's key messages as adherence to the Constitution, transparency and accountability, and an end to political game-playing, and said he is passionate about personal freedoms and helping small businesses.
